features: Equipped with a 2.4 inch HD flip screen, this digital photography camera makes selfie taking and content previewing easy and intuitive. The clear display allows for easy operating, enabling you to see and adjust your shots with accuracy to achieve the good composition every time.

18X Digital Zoom: Experience the ability to catch distant subjects with ease using the 18X digital zoom. The high speed autofocus ensures that every shotting is clear and vivid, allowing you to photograph scenes and details beyond the reach of the naked eye.

This digital zoom camera offers a variety of entertaining and innovative functions, including 3, 5 second self timers, timestamping, multiple filter effects, and loop recording. It also includes entertaining features like games and a music function, adding a playful item to your photography experience.

With an 800 mAh battery, this 1080P digital camera provides up to 4 hours of continuous recording time, making it suitable for a full day of outdoor photography without the worry of running out of power. This long battery life ensures that you can catch all your adventures without interruption.
description: The digital camera features a powerful 48MP sensor and 1080P resolution, delivering stunningly detailed photos and videos. Whether you're recording a film or capturing daily moments, this camera offers an incredible visual impact. With a built in LED fill light, it excels in low light conditions, ensuring every moment is caught with clarity.
